svg.title: Act
svg.desc: Command: drag <from> <to>, What it does: Drag one element onto another.; Command: upload <target> <files…>, What it does: Answer a file chooser, including one behind a styled button.; Command: dialog accept, dialog dismiss, What it does: Dialogs never block: each alert, confirm or prompt is accepted by default, and the reply of the action that raised it reports it. dialog dismiss changes how the next one is answered (--text answers a prompt); dialog alone lists the ones seen.
